run_glue_rte_preprocessing: run the Glue_RTE main function to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_glue_rte_dataset: create a Glue_RTE instance to load and preprocess the GLUE RTE natural language inference dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace GLUE RTE dataset split to a list of sentence pairs with entailment labels
load_glue_rte_dataset: load the GLUE RTE dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the Glue_RTE dataset with a specified seed
